The '''J'Mer Sab''', also called '''Night Wind''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled resistance group that arose on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. It was a fraud set up by the Colonial Government, composed of "trustees" from among the native population. After the organization gathered a large number of real resistance movers, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Marsh Limoth]] would "bust" the organization, and thus net the resistance movers.
